generator.title: Architecture Blueprint Generator
generator.subtitle: Step-by-step technical specifications and architectural blueprints generation from approved Quotations.

eligibility.draft_ineligible: Revision is in Draft status and has not been approved.
eligibility.missing_scope: Scope of work has not been defined.
eligibility.unsupported_scheme: Commercial scheme is not supported for automated blueprint generation.
eligibility.superseding_warning: This revision has been superseded by a newer approved revision.

context.title: Solution Context & Business Goals
context.description: Synthesizes business goals, target personas, and technical constraints from the source quotation.

journey.title: User Journey
journey.description: Maps user interaction flows, chronological phases, actors, and system touchpoints.

architecture.title: System Architecture
architecture.description: Designs component diagrams, architectural modules, databases, and service relations.

state_machine.title: State Machine
state_machine.description: Defines core entities, state lifecycles, transition events, and system action guards.

workflow.title: Business Workflow
workflow.description: Structures cross-functional business process flows with role-based swimlanes.

wbs.title: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)
wbs.description: Organizes module hierarchies, feature acceptance criteria, and cross-reference matrices.

cross_validation.title: Cross-Validation & Consistency
cross_validation.description: Validates architectural dependency integrity and structural consistency across all sections.

errors.foreign_404_desc: The requested blueprint was not found or you do not have permission to access this tenant data.
errors.stale_lease_desc: Pipeline has not received updates for over 5 minutes. The execution lock may have expired.
errors.stale_conflict_desc: The content version on the server was updated by another user or background job.
errors.empty_section_warning: This section does not yet have any business data rows.
errors.provider_config_missing: AI provider configuration is missing or the API key is invalid. Please check system settings.

invalidation.warning_desc: This section was previously completed. Editing and resaving it will invalidate the current results and re-run the following downstream sections:
invalidation.confirm_checkbox: I understand and agree that the downstream sections listed above will be re-run.

recovery.success_desc: Section data has been saved and validated. Click "Continue Generation" to proceed to the next blueprint stage.

empty_states.no_revisions: No eligible revisions available for blueprint generation.

mobile_notice.desktop_authoring_hint: Blueprint manual authoring and data entry forms are optimized for desktop screens. On mobile devices, data is displayed in a read-only summary mode.

visual_editor.title: Visual Editor
visual_editor.mobile_warning_desc: Visual editor is optimized for desktop screens. Current mode is read-only review without direct modification capabilities.
visual_editor.recovery_desc: This section failed during automated generation. You can complete and structure it manually in the Visual Editor below, then click Mark Completed to proceed.
visual_editor.conflict_desc: Data on the server has been updated by another session or background job. Your local changes are preserved in the editor buffer.
visual_editor.unsaved_leave_desc: You have unsaved draft changes. Are you sure you want to leave and discard local edits?
